entry.title: Welcoming New NSERC and Honours Students for Summer Research

entry.content: We welcome a new cohort of NSERC USRA and Honours students exploring topics in cardiac physiology, sarcomere modeling, and metabolic health. These students bring great energy and ideas to the lab this summer.
